UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated MINOVA AI user account profile metadata isolated to the account owner.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown in the MINOVA AI interface.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
